The **2011–12 Florida Gators men's basketball team** represented the University of Florida in the sport of basketball during the [2011–12 college basketball season](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2011%E2%80%9312_NCAA_Division_I_men's_basketball_season "2011–12 NCAA Division I men's basketball season"). The Gators competed in Division I of the National Collegiate Athletic Association (NCAA) and the Southeastern Conference (SEC). They were led by head coach Billy Donovan, and played their home games in the [O'Connell Center](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/O'Connell_Center "O'Connell Center") on the university's Gainesville, Florida campus.
The Gators finished the SEC regular season with a 10–6 conference record, and lost to Kentucky in the semifinals of the [2012 SEC tournament](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2012_SEC_men's_basketball_tournament "2012 SEC men's basketball tournament"). They received an at-large bid to the [2012 NCAA tournament](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2012_NCAA_Division_I_men's_basketball_tournament "2012 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament") as a No. 7 seed in the West Region, where they advanced to the Elite Eight before losing to [Louisville](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2011%E2%80%9312_Louisville_Cardinals_men's_basketball_team "2011–12 Louisville Cardinals men's basketball team").

The Gators finished the 2010–11 season 29–8, 13–3 in SEC play and lost in the Elite Eight round of the [NCAA tournament](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2011_NCAA_Division_I_men's_basketball_tournament "2011 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament") to [Butler](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2010%E2%80%9311_Butler_Bulldogs_men's_basketball_team "2010–11 Butler Bulldogs men's basketball team"). Senior small forward Chandler Parsons won SEC Player of the Year honors, and head coach Billy Donovan was named SEC Coach of the Year. Parsons and senior power forward Vernon Macklin were both selected in the 2011 NBA draft.

The **2011–12 Florida Gators men's basketball team** represented the University of Florida in the sport of basketball during the [2011–12 college basketball season](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2011%E2%80%9312_NCAA_Division_I_men's_basketball_season "2011–12 NCAA Division I men's basketball season"). The Gators finished the SEC regular season with a 10–6 conference record, and lost to Kentucky in the semifinals of the [2012 SEC tournament](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2012_SEC_men's_basketball_tournament "2012 SEC men's basketball tournament"). They received an at-large bid to the [2012 NCAA tournament](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2012_NCAA_Division_I_men's_basketball_tournament "2012 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament") as a No. 7 seed in the West Region, where they advanced to the Elite Eight before losing to [Louisville](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2011%E2%80%9312_Louisville_Cardinals_men's_basketball_team "2011–12 Louisville Cardinals men's basketball team").
